arabic text: Kareem-e-Karb-o-Bala Mojza Dikha Dijay.\nKarbala Yaad Bohat Aati Hai Bula Lijay.
english translation text: O Generous One of Karbala, show a miracle.\nI miss Karbala greatly—call me there.

arabic text: Hussain Aap Jo Chahein Tu Kuch Nahi Mushkil.\nTarap Raha Hai Bohat Karbala Ki Yaad Mein Dil.\nPhir Aik Bar Mujhe Karbala Dikha Dijay.
english translation text: Hussain, nothing is difficult if you will it.\nMy heart writhes with longing for Karbala.\nLet me behold Karbala once again.

arabic text: Tumhare Rozay Pe Aane Mein Aaj Diqqat Hai.\nMagar Khabar Hai Tumhein Mujh Ko Kitni Chahat Hai.\nMain Sar Ke Bal Chala Aaon Ga Bas Sada Dijay.
english translation text: Today there are obstacles preventing me from reaching your shrine,\nbut you know how deeply I long for it.\nI will come walking upon my head—only call me.

arabic text: Mere Khiyal Mein Jab Aaye Do Katay Bazu.\nAlam Ko Dekh Ke Aankhon Mein Aa Gaye Aanso.\nTarap Raha Hoon Alamdar Se Mila Dijay.
english translation text: When your two severed arms enter my thoughts,\ntears fill my eyes upon seeing the standard.\nI long for the standard-bearer—reunite me with him.

arabic text: Galuye Asghar-e-Be Sheer Chid Gaya Tha Jidhar.\nSabeel Doodh Ki Ja Kar Lagaon Main Bhi Udhar.\nMain Zairon Se Kahon Ga Mujhe Dua Dijay.
english translation text: Where speechless Asghar's throat was pierced,\nI too will establish a milk stall there.\nI will ask the visitors to pray for me.

arabic text: Kissi Bhi Haal Mein Jana Hai Rooz-e-Ashora. Lahu\nBadan Se Bahana Hai Rooz-e-Ashora.\nHai Matami Ki Sada Phir Humein Sada Dijay.
english translation text: In every condition I must go on Ashura.\nOn Ashura, blood must flow from the body.\nThis is the mourner's cry—call us once again.

arabic text: Bulaein Aap Jisay Chahein Apne Rozay Par.\nGhulam Aap Ki Taqseem Pe Hain Razi Magar.\nSakon Dil Ko Miley Kis Tarha Bata Dijay.
english translation text: You call whomever you wish to your shrine.\nYour servant accepts your distribution,\nbut tell me: how can this heart find peace?

arabic text: Hain Ashk Aankhon Mein Our Dil Udas Hai Mera.\nMujhe Bulaein Gaye Kab Aap Karbala Maula.\nKuch Aa Ke Khuwab Mein Hi Mujh Ko Aasra Dijay.
english translation text: My eyes are filled with tears and my heart is sorrowful.\nMaula, when will you call me to Karbala?\nCome at least within a dream and give me support.

arabic text: Sada REHAN-E-Azza Ki Hai Bar Zaban-e-RAZA:.\nMain Arbaeen Pe Mashi Karon Ga Aye MAula.\nPhir Aik Bar Mujhe Paon Par Chala Dijay.
english translation text: This plea of Rehan-e-Aza remains upon Raza's tongue:\nO Maula, I will walk on Arbaeen.\nLet me walk upon my feet once again.
